from datetime import datetime

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .models import Payment
from .money import ZERO, round_money


def process_refund_request(payment: Payment, amount, requested_by, at: datetime) -> Payment:
    """Refund part or all of a captured payment on behalf of a support agent.

    ``amount`` is the text the support agent typed; it is rounded to the cent.
    Only captured payments can be refunded, the amount must be positive, and
    the total refunded must never exceed the captured amount.
    """
    if payment.status != "captured":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")

    refund = round_money(amount)
    if refund <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(refund))

    already_refunded = round_money(payment.refunded_amount)
    if already_refunded + refund > payment.amount:
        raise BillingError(
            "refund_exceeds_captured",
            f"{already_refunded + refund} > {payment.amount}",
        )

    ensure_utc(at)

    payment.refunded_amount = already_refunded + refund
    if payment.refunded_amount >= payment.amount:
        payment.status = "refunded"

    audit.record(
        "payment_refunded",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=refund,
        requested_by=requested_by,
    )
    return payment

"""Entry points used by the support console."""

from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .models import Payment
from .money import ZERO, round_money

APPROVAL_THRESHOLD = Decimal("500.00")


def process_refund_request(
    payment: Payment,
    amount,
    requested_by,
    at: datetime,
    *,
    idempotency_key=None,
    approved_by=None,
) -> Payment:
    """Refund part or all of a captured payment on behalf of a support agent.

    ``amount`` is the text the support agent typed; it is rounded to the cent.
    Only captured payments can be refunded, the amount must be positive, and
    the total refunded must never exceed the captured amount.

    ``idempotency_key`` makes retries safe: if an audit entry with the same key
    already exists, the original result is returned without applying the
    refund again.  Refunds above 500.00 require ``approved_by`` (FIN-2026-03).
    """
    if idempotency_key is not None:
        for entry in audit.events():
            if entry.get("idempotency_key") == idempotency_key:
                return payment

    if payment.status != "captured":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")

    refund = round_money(amount)
    if refund <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(refund))

    if refund > APPROVAL_THRESHOLD and approved_by is None:
        raise BillingError("approval_required")

    already_refunded = round_money(payment.refunded_amount)
    if already_refunded + refund > payment.amount:
        raise BillingError(
            "refund_exceeds_captured",
            f"{already_refunded + refund} > {payment.amount}",
        )

    ensure_utc(at)

    payment.refunded_amount = already_refunded + refund
    if payment.refunded_amount >= payment.amount:
        payment.status = "refunded"

    audit.record(
        "payment_refunded",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=refund,
        requested_by=requested_by,
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
    )
    return payment
EOF
python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5"}

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.support import process_refund_request
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError
T0=datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
def p(): return Payment("pay_1","inv_1",Decimal("1000.00"),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)

# idempotency
x=p(); process_refund_request(x,"40.00","u",T0,idempotency_key="k1")
process_refund_request(x,"40.00","u",T0,idempotency_key="k1")
assert x.refunded_amount==Decimal("40.00"), x.refunded_amount
assert audit.events()[-1]["idempotency_key"]=="k1"

# approval
y=p()
try: process_refund_request(y,"500.01","u",T0)
except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="approval_required"
else: raise AssertionError
process_refund_request(y,"500.00","u",T0)
process_refund_request(y,"500.01","u",T0,approved_by="mgr")
assert y.status=="refunded", y.status

# rounding
z=p(); process_refund_request(z,"49.999","u",T0); assert z.refunded_amount==Decimal("50.00")
print("all edge cases ok")
EOF"}
